names.official: Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka

summary: Sri Lanka requires almost all visitors to obtain an Electronic Travel Authorization (ETA) before arrival — around 50 USD for a 30-day double-entry tourist visit — while a fee-waiver scheme covering dozens of nationalities, including India, China and Russia, has made the ETA free for many travelers. Apply only at the official eta.gov.lk.

primarySources.name: Sri Lanka Electronic Travel Authorization System (official)
Department of Immigration and Emigration of Sri Lanka

notes: Duty-free allowance includes 2 bottles of wine and 1.5 liters of spirits per adult; cigarettes are not part of the duty-free allowance and attract high duty.
No arrival card is currently required for air arrivals — passenger details are captured through the ETA.

payments.text: Cards are accepted in hotels, supermarkets and tourist restaurants in Colombo and resort areas, but tuk-tuks, guesthouses, small shops and rural areas run on cash. ATMs are widespread in towns.

safety.text: Sri Lanka is generally safe for visitors. Watch for petty scams around tourist sites and tuk-tuk overcharging, take care in the ocean (strong currents), and keep an eye on local news — economic-crisis-era protests have flared occasionally.

source.name: UK Foreign, Commonwealth & Development Office — Sri Lanka travel advice

bestTimeToVisit.text: December to March is dry and sunny on the west and south coasts and in the hill country — peak season. The east coast (Trincomalee, Arugam Bay) is best from May to September.

idp.text: Sri Lanka is a party to the 1949 Geneva Convention on Road Traffic but not to the 1968 Vienna one, so the International Driving Permit it is bound to recognize is the 1949 Geneva version. A permit issued under the 1968 Vienna Convention carries no treaty obligation here.

A permit issued under the 1968 Vienna Convention carries no treaty obligation here. Whether a permit is required in addition to a national license, and for how long a foreign license may be used, are set by national road law and have not been checked for Sri Lanka yet.

tips.text: Apply only at the official eta.gov.lk. Lookalike ETA websites rank high in search results and charge double or triple the official fee, or sell authorisations that never arrive.

Sri Lanka's free-visa scheme has changed repeatedly since 2024, in both the covered nationalities and its end date. Check the official portal shortly before travel rather than relying on old news articles.
Sri Lanka has two monsoons hitting opposite coasts at different times. There is always a dry coast. Pick west/south for December–March and east for May–September.
Disrespect toward Buddhist imagery is taken seriously: visible Buddha tattoos have led to refused entry or deportation, and posing for photos with your back to a Buddha statue can cause trouble.

faq.question: Do US citizens need a visa for Sri Lanka?
faq.answer: Yes — an Electronic Travel Authorization (ETA) obtained before travel at eta.gov.lk. The standard tourist ETA costs about 50 USD, allows 30 days with double entry, and is usually approved within 24–48 hours. Check the portal for current fee waivers.

faq.question: Which nationalities get Sri Lanka's ETA free of charge?
faq.answer: Since late 2024 Sri Lanka has waived the ETA fee for a list of nationalities including India, China, Russia, Japan, Indonesia and Thailand, and has announced expansions to dozens more. The list and end date have changed several times. An ETA application is still required, so check eta.gov.lk for the current position.

faq.question: Can I extend my 30-day stay in Sri Lanka?
faq.answer: Yes. The tourist visa can be extended by the Department of Immigration and Emigration (in Colombo or online), typically first to 90 days and then in further steps up to roughly 270 days total. Fees depend on nationality.

faq.question: How long does the Sri Lanka ETA take?
faq.answer: Most applications are approved within 24–48 hours, and many within hours. Apply at least a few days before departure in case of extra checks, and carry a printout or PDF of the approval notice.

faq.question: What documents does Sri Lanka require on arrival?
faq.answer: A passport valid for 6 months, the ETA approval, a confirmed onward or return ticket, and proof of sufficient funds for your stay. Immigration does not always ask for the last two, but airlines can check the ticket at check-in.
